notes.subject: ⟨a yɛrɛ⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew תודע is passive/reflexive 'is made known'; Bambara needs the reflexive pronoun supplied

notes.subject: תודע
notes.rationale: 'Wisdom makes itself known even among fools' (BSB) vs 'what is in the midst of fools is made known' i.e. their folly exposed (KJV/ASV)

notes.subject: תנוח / תודע
notes.rationale: parallel verb pair rest/be-known frames the contrast discerning/fools; chiasm lost in Bambara

translation: Dɔnninɛtigi ka dusukun kɔnɔ, hikima bɛ jɔ a la; nka balow cogoyа kɔnɔ, ⟨a yɛrɛ⟩ bɛ jira.
